[SWS_TcpIp_00125] ⌈The service TcpIp_TcpTransmit() shall retrieve exactly
AvailableLength bytes from the upper layer if the parameter DataPtr is a
NULL_PTR and ForceRetrieve is TRUE. (If DataPtr is a NULL_PTR and ForceRe-
trieve is FALSE, TcpIp may retrieve less data then available).⌋
Note: The TCP segment(s) are sent dependent on runtime factors (e.g. receive win-
dow) and configuration parameter (e.g. Nagle algorithm).
